title: Klikety Macros
description: Macro recordings for Klikety v2. Supports absolute and window-relative position modes.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file. Enables editor IntelliSense.

macros.description: 10-slot macro array. Index = slot number. Null = empty slot.

macroDefinition.description: A named macro recording with screen context and ordered steps.

screenWidth.description: Screen width in physical pixels at recording time.

screenHeight.description: Screen height in physical pixels at recording time.

dpiScale.description: DPI scale factor at recording time (e.g. 1.0, 1.25, 1.5).

speedModifier.description: Per-macro speed multiplier. 1.0 = original speed, 0.5 = double speed, 2.0 = half speed. Overrides the global macros.speedModifier in config.json when set.

positionMode.description: Coordinate mode: absolute (screen) or windowRelative (target window).

windowWidth.description: Target window width in physical pixels. Required when positionMode is windowRelative.

windowHeight.description: Target window height in physical pixels. Required when positionMode is windowRelative.

windowTitlePattern.description: Substring to match in target window title. Required when positionMode is windowRelative.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the action.

relativeTimeMs.description: Delay before this step in milliseconds (relative to recording start).

endX.description: End X coordinate for drag operations.

endY.description: End Y coordinate for drag operations.

scrollDelta.description: Scroll wheel delta for scroll operations.

dragButton.description: Mouse button used for drag operations.

startFromCursor.description: When true, DragDrop starts from current cursor position instead of recorded start point.
